reasoning: Reviewed the unchanged 700x607 panel first, then the complete candidate table and every adjudication review item. The extractable series is the blue open-circle CO2 195K curve; the coral N2 77K curve is excluded by spec and was not edited. The native plateau crop shows multiple clearly visible blue open-circle markers omitted from the 46-row candidate table, so I added only centres supported by native ring geometry. The dense low-pressure rise was inspected at enlarged native scale; several glyphs are fused and their centres are not defensibly separable, so I did not infer points from expected spacing or smoothness.
